fields.label: Customer
fields.description: Leave blank and use 'New Customer Name' if not yet in the system

fields.label: New Customer Name
fields.description: For a brand-new lead who isn't a Customer yet - just note their company name here for now.

fields.label: Contact Name
fields.description: Who to follow up with.

fields.label: Phone
fields.description: A phone or WhatsApp number for following up on this enquiry.

fields.label: Source
fields.options:
Portal
Salesman
Commission Agent
Phone
Walk-in
Email
fields.description: How this enquiry reached you. Feeds the "Enquiry Source Breakdown" chart on the workspace - over time this shows which channel actually brings in work.

fields.label: Salesman / Agent
fields.description: If a commission agent or salesman brought this in, link them here.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Updates automatically as this enquiry moves through the system - set to Estimating on conversion, Quoted once a Quotation exists, Won/Lost once the deal is decided.

fields.label: Print Estimate
fields.description: Set automatically when you click "Convert to Estimate".

fields.label: What are we printing?
fields.options:
Folding Carton
Business Card
Flyer
Sticker
Other
fields.description: Choose the closest product. The estimator will confirm the technical production details.

fields.label: How many do you need?
fields.description: Enter the number of finished pieces required, for example 1,000 boxes or 5,000 flyers.

fields.label: Additional details (optional)
fields.description: Share any details you already know, or leave these blank and Golden Arrow will help you choose.

fields.label: Finished Width (cm)
fields.description: The final size after cutting or folding, if known.

fields.label: Finished Height (cm)
fields.description: The final size after cutting or folding, if known.

fields.label: Printed Sides
fields.description: Choose whether the design is printed on one face or on both faces.

fields.label: Colours on Front
fields.description: Leave blank if you are unsure. Full colour is normally 4.

fields.label: Colours on Back
fields.description: Leave blank for one-sided printing.

fields.label: When do you need it?
fields.description: Your preferred delivery date. Golden Arrow will confirm availability in the quotation.

fields.label: Paper / Material Preference
fields.description: Example: 350gsm ivory board, glossy paper, or 'please recommend'.

fields.label: Finishing Requirements
fields.description: Example: lamination, die cutting, folding, gluing, foil, or special packing.

fields.label: Artwork or Reference File
fields.description: Optional: attach your design, dieline, sample photo, PDF, or any useful reference.

fields.label: Notes / Rough Spec
fields.description: Anything else the estimator should know.
